headline: Alem Leather Works PLC ranks 1st with 78/100 points, fully eligible under the investment readiness track.
whyThisRank: Alem Leather Works PLC leads the batch at rank 1 with 78 of 100 points, fully verified across all eligibility requirements with zero adverse findings. It outranks competitors by securing maximum scores in intervention results, green sector alignment, baseline employment, and international market reach.
justification: Alem Leather Works PLC achieves rank 1 with 78 out of 100 total points, fully satisfying eligibility requirements with 8 years of operational history. Evaluated under the investment readiness track (7b) due to requested equipment, the application secured maximum scores in intervention results (20/20), social/environmental impact (10/10), baseline headcount (5/5), and international market reach (5/5). The business exhibits strong gender integration with 40% female ownership and 41.9% female employment, alongside a projected creation of 21 new jobs. Scored deductions occurred in youth employment (25.8%), sales growth (30.6%), management team size (3 members), local raw material sourcing (70%), and job creation potential (15/25).
strengths: Full scores achieved for expected intervention results (20/20) and positive green-sector impact (10/10).
Maximum points secured for baseline employment (31 total employees) and export/international market reach (5/5).
High gender inclusion, featuring 40% female ownership and 41.9% female staff.
watchouts: Lower points awarded for youth employment participation at 25.8% (2/5 points).
Product USP is not new to the Ethiopian market (3/5 points).
Job creation potential scored 15 out of 25 points based on 21 planned jobs.
